description: We're Attack on Anthropic, six high school students from Canada who've spent an unreasonable amount of time in basements building robots, debugging code, and convincing ourselves that one more hour will fix everything. Between robotics competitions, hackathons, and questionable sleep schedules, we've developed a habit of turning simple ideas into engineering problems. We've spent enough time trying to make robots survive on Earth. Now we're curious about what's beyond the walls.
